title: Game definition: Senet (ancient Egyptian race game)
description: Senet: 2-player, 30-square linear track (3×10 grid traversed in S-pattern), 5 pieces per player. Throw sticks for movement (binary dice: 1-5). Special squares: House of Rebirth, House of Water (restart), House of Three Truths, House of Re-Atoum. Race to bear off all pieces. One of the oldest known board games (~3100 BCE). Rules reconstructed from Kendall 1978 and Piccione 1980.
